newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo state debt deal seen by end Nov - Parente.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo state debt deal seen by end Nov - Parente.

text.p: A Brazilian Finance Ministry official said the federal government would reach an agreement with Sao Paulo by the end of November to resolve the state's debt problem, including that of troubled state bank Banespa.

Finance Ministry Executive Secretary Pedro Parente, who spoke a lunch with businessmen in Rio de Janeiro, would not comment on the nature of the debt deal, saying any premature announcement could harm negotiations.
He said the federal government had reached debt agreements or was in negotiations with another 15 states.

The finances of Brazil's states are considered the main source of the country's operational public sector deficit. Government analysts expect that gap to total between 3.5 to four percent of gross domestic product this year.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
